desc.zh: 把无限循环小数变成精确分数，辨认不同写法背后的同一个数。
desc.en: Turn repeating decimals into exact fractions and compare different spellings.

complexity: O(n) parsing time; O(n) auxiliary space under the official bounded-digit arithmetic model

concepts.name: Repeating decimal cancellation
concepts.description: Shift a repeating tail by its block length and subtract.

concepts.name: Exact rational invariant
concepts.description: Each parsed part contributes its exact place-value fraction.
